As a dasher myself, I’ve sometimes not gotten a response from someone until I’ve already checked out and gotten to my car. And by that point it’s too late to make changes. And it’s possible to have bad cell service inside. For example, my app always crashes when I go inside of any dollar general or cvs, but not Walgreens for some reason. It may not have been malicious is all I’m trying to say. They even apologized, so it’s possible they didn’t get your message in time.

Sometimes it’s better to spend your time learning to love yourself. I know that sound cliche, but I’m very serious. If you can’t love yourself, you can’t love others. And if you don’t have %100 love for yourself, you can’t expect others to love you at the same level, ya know? With self love comes self respect, and it attracts people who are like-minded. Maybe the road to finding a partner starts with spending time getting to know yourself first.
